name: Outfall to the river (J2)
purpose: A cold vestibule between the glacier and the return corridor where all of B1's corridor water slides east over a basalt lip into a dark shaft toward the river 22 m below; you hear it before you see it, and a cold updraft lifts the mist.

ceiling_profile.note: 3 m basalt barrel; opens upward into the shaft void over the lip (east end).

spurs.note: Dead-end viewing spur to the rail at the lip.

hero.why: Where B1's water leaves: the pool slides over a polished lip into blackness, lit from below so the sheet glows; the sound carries down the corridor. It is the only bright thing at the end of a dark spur.

anchored.why: Stops walkers 1 m short of the lip.
One low toro on the kerb by the rail.

water.note: Corridor water moving east (barely perceptible) to the lip.

sightlines.see: East down the dark spur to the glowing sheet at the lip; sound of falling water.
The warm noren and niches of the return corridor to the west.

concept.match: Mood of the water-journey diagram at B1: water leaving the level through a lit opening; corridor stones and mist in the foreground, a glowing sheet falling into darkness at the end.

lights.why: Few niches, stopping 6 m short of the lip.

dressing.why: The walk itself: two staggered rows of polished pads (tops at -20.00, water 5 cm lower) make a 1.5 m path; this is the nav line.
The walk itself: two staggered rows of polished pads (tops at -20.00, water 5 cm lower) make a 1.5 m path; this is the nav line.
Low wet rocks where the pool meets the kerb: detail at the edges, middle kept open.

mood.key: glowing sheet falling into the dark
mood.palette: cold teal water, black basalt, one warm under-light
mood.mist: Low mist dragged east and lifted by the shaft updraft at the lip.

conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
